messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-ash — Elevated 5xx rate detected on edge-gateway -> frontend-pool (alert: 5xx_ratio > 3% for 5m). Dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/5523456789

oncall-ash: Acked. I'm on the page. seeing spikes in 502/504 from gateway. pulling logs now.

maria-engineering: I can repro a sample: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' 'https://edge.redwood.example/api/v1/complete' || true -> getting 502 consistently (5/5).

maria-engineering: envoy admin shows repeated upstream host 503/504 and heavy retry counters on route "api-v1". snippet from /stats:

```
cluster.backend_frontend.upstream_rq_5xx: 412
cluster.backend_frontend.upstream_rq_timeouts: 128
listener.0.0.0.0:443.router.retry: 1024
```

devin-runtime: That retry counter is worrying — could be amplifying failures. When gateway retries a request to a failing host it can cascade. Any recent config pushes to gateway?

oncall-ash: No deploys in last 30m, but we did rotate a load balancer route weight rollout ~10m ago to shift traffic to new pool (edge-pool-b).

samir-sre: Rolling weight changes + aggressive retries + low per-host circuit thresholds = perfect storm. Can we temporarily shift traffic back to stable pool (edge-pool-a) and disable retries at the gateway route?

oncall-ash: Agreed. Plan: 1) reduce route-retries to 0 2) shift 100% weight to edge-pool-a 3) raise circuit-breaker thresholds to allow connection bursts. I'll execute and report.

oncall-ash: Executing weight change:
```
# management API
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API' \
  https://controlplane.redwood.example/v1/routes/edge-gateway/weight \
  -d '{"route":"api-v1","weights":{"edge-pool-a":1.0,"edge-pool-b":0.0}}'
```

maria-engineering: Also patching route retry config:
```
PATCH /configs/edge-gateway/routes/api-v1
{ "retries": { "retry_on": "none", "num_retries": 0 } }
```

devin-runtime: Pushed retry patch. Confirmed via envoy admin: route retry counter stopped increasing.

samir-sre: Increasing circuit breaker limits for cluster backend_frontend: max_requests -> 10000, max_connections -> 2000 via controlplane.

oncall-ash: All three emergency changes applied. Monitoring -> https://monitoring.redwood.example/d/edge/5xx?from=-15m shows 5xx dropping from 3.8% -> 0.9% within 2 minutes. :white_check_mark:

jessica-support: Heads up — support is opening incident banner and contacting top 5 affected customers (ticket ids: INC-9021, INC-9022). Estimated customer impact: API v1 traffic saw ~12% of requests hit errors during the spike window.

maria-engineering: Quick debug notes: envoy upstream health checks for edge-pool-b suddenly started returning 503 after route rollout, likely misconfigured backend listener or new hosts not ready. No signs of increased CPU/memory on hosts, but connection resets spiked. attaching sample logs.

maria-engineering: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T10:02:12Z] upstream_conn reset: ECONNRESET -> host-12.edge-pool-b.internal:443
[2026-03-15T10:02:12Z] outgoing request retries=1 route=api-v1
```

devin-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: host readiness probe mismatch after pool rotation + LB weight change exposed unhealthy hosts, gateway retries retried to other hosts but circuit breakers tripped causing 5xx.

samir-sre: For follow-up: revert the pool rollout, add a readiness gate to deployment pipeline, add canary traffic step that validates healthchecks before shifting >10% traffic. I'll open an infra ticket.

oncall-ash: Immediate mitigations successful, but we left retries disabled. We'll re-enable with conservative settings after hosts validated.

jessica-support: Customer comms: drafting status page update now, will link to postmortem once done.

oncall-ash: Handing over to @samir-sre for overnight as I go offline in 20m. Notes: emergency weight->edge-pool-a, retries=0, circuit-breakers relaxed. watch for rebound if we re-enable retries.

samir-sre: Taking over. will keep monitoring for 2h and coordinate rollback plan. tagging @maria-engineering and @devin-runtime for config fixes.

oncall-ash: Thanks team — filing incident ticket: INC-2026-345, assigning to infra for rollout fix + postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 created. Severity: Sev2. Playbook: https://playbooks.redwood.example/sev2-routing

jessica-support: Logged affected accounts and outreach started. ETA for full recovery (post-fix): 6h for deployment validation + 24h for postmortem.

samir-sre: Will add a follow-up action list: 1) patch readiness checks 2) add canary health validation step 3) add automated rollback when upstream 5xx > 1% for 3m 4) update runbook to include retry throttling guidance.

maria-engineering: Leaving CI job artifacts and envoy config diffs in the ticket.

oncall-ash: Signing off. Hand-off complete. :handshake:

samir-sre: Acknowledged. monitoring alerts to remain on for the window. If 5xx creeps up, escalate to oncall-rotation.
